description: This Java source file defines the class KVTypeInfo, which provides reflection-based access to indexed fields of types managed within a key-value store (KVStore). It handles annotations, accessors, and index validation.

classes.name: KVTypeInfo
classes.description: A utility class that wraps around a Java class type to provide easy access to its annotated index fields within a KVStore context.

methods.name: KVTypeInfo
methods.description: Constructor that initializes index and accessor mappings based on annotations in the provided class type.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the class type associated with this KVTypeInfo.

methods.name: getIndexValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified index from an instance of the wrapped type.

methods.name: indices
methods.description: Returns a stream of all KVIndex annotations associated with the type.

methods.name: getAccessor
methods.description: Returns the accessor (field or method) for a given index name.

methods.name: getParentAccessor
methods.description: Returns the accessor for the parent index, if any.

methods.name: getParentIndexName
methods.description: Returns the name of the parent index for a given index.
